title: Vibrant Tangy Slovakian Chicken Skewers
description: Tangy and snappy post-workout Slovakian dish featuring freshly chopped parsley and miso-marinate, perfect for a quick and refreshing meal.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the miso marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto the soaked wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Sprinkle the freshly chopped parsley over the skewers during the last minute of grilling.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Serve the Vibrant Tangy Slovakian Chicken Skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
